analyzed_vuln.description: Category range evaluation assumes both range operands are valid CIL_DATUM category objects and blindly dereferences/casts i1->data and i2->data as struct cil_symtab_datum/struct cil_cat. For malformed/resolution-expanded expressions, a non-datum list item can reach this helper via __cil_expr_to_bitmap(op==CIL_RANGE, flavor==CIL_CAT), so c1/c2 are derived from invalid memory and c1->value/c2->value are read out-of-bounds (ASan crash at line 1211). The root cause is missing operand flavor/type validation before dereference/cast in this helper (and call path).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered when parsing/evaluating a category expression containing a range in MLS level/category context (e.g., sidcontext/levelrange cats) where resolved datum_expr includes unexpected/non-datum operands (from copied nested catset/list expression structure). During post-processing, __evaluate_cat_expression -> __cil_expr_to_bitmap takes CIL_RANGE path and passes curr->next/curr->next->next directly; if those items are not validated CIL_DATUM category/catalias nodes, __cil_cat_expr_range_to_bitmap_helper performs invalid cast/dereference and reads before allocated heap object, causing heap-buffer-overflow.
